title: Harmless accountability swarm proof
objective: Create docs/accountability-smoke.md as a disposable candidate artifact. It must contain the heading '# Accountability Smoke Proof' and the sentence 'No product code changed.' Do not modify any other file.
acceptanceCriteria: The candidate changes exactly docs/accountability-smoke.md and no other path.
The document contains the required heading and safety sentence.
No product, configuration, dependency, deployment, authentication, billing, or infrastructure code changes.

args: const fs=require('node:fs');const p='docs/accountability-smoke.md';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!s.includes('# Accountability Smoke Proof')||!s.includes('No product code changed.'))process.exit(1);

analysts.responsibility: Confirm the exact one-file scope from the contract and existing docs path only. Do not survey unrelated repository areas.

builders.responsibility: Create the smallest document satisfying the exact proof contract.
Independently create the proof document while preserving the one-file safety boundary.

reviewers.responsibility: Independently verify that the frozen candidate changes only the allowed documentation path.
Independently verify the required content and try to falsify the safety claim.
